description: SYNTHORA x402-preflight: Before you pay an x402 endpoint: fetches its 402 challenge WITHOUT paying and checks it against the public x402 discovery catalog (daily copies of today and yesterday): same payTo, normal price (no spike), recent buyers and calls, wallet changed since yesterday, official USDC (or EURC) asset for the network, valid TLS, and your own expected payTo and max price. Returns pay / caution / do-not-pay with every signal, a plain-language note by our own model (marked as AI) and a self-resolving calibration question. https only, public addresses only, never pays. Ed25519-signe [x402: 0.005 USDC per call on Base]
